info.title: Calendoro API
info.description: Scheduling API: event types, availability, bookings, webhooks and more. Times are ISO 8601 instants. Lists return `{ data, nextCursor }`; pass nextCursor as `cursor` for the next page. Send `Calendoro-Version` to pin a dated API version.

bearer.description: Session token (cds_), API key (cdo_, or cdo_test_ for a separate test organization) or OAuth access token (cdoa_)

ValidationFailed.description: `validation_failed`: the body, query or path was invalid; `details` lists the issues.

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: the token is missing, invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the credential lacks the scope, or this route needs a user session.

RateLimited.description: `rate_limited`: slow down and retry after the `Retry-After` header.

Sent 15 minutes after the start of a Calendoro Meet booking that still stands when no host has joined. Only for bookings made while an endpoint was subscribed.

Verify the `Calendoro-Signature` header before trusting the body. Delivery is at least once.
